```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

schools  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
visits   <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "visits.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
surveys  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "surveys.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
issues   <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "issues.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Read open issues for the issues section
issues_open <- if (file.exists(here("data", "clean", "issues_open.csv"))) {
  read_csv(here("data", "clean", "issues_open.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  issues
}

# Read full update data
raw_full <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "full_update.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
clean_full <- raw_full |>
  slice(-1) |>
  rename(school_name = Q2) |>
  mutate(school_name = str_trim(school_name))

# Date range defaults: current school year (Aug 1 – Jul 31)
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
date_min <- school_year_start
date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())

# Build the full data object for all schools
all_school_data <- list()
for (name in sort(schools$school_name)) {
  slug <- name |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("-$")

  school_visits <- visits |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

  all_school_data[[slug]] <- list(
    info        = schools |> filter(school_name == name) |> as.list(),
    visits      = school_visits,
    full_update = clean_full |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character)),
    issues      = issues |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character)),
    open_issues = issues_open |> filter(school_name == name) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  )
}

# Build dropdown options
school_options <- schools |>
  arrange(school_name) |>
  transmute(
    name = school_name,
    slug = school_name |>
      str_to_lower() |>
      str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
      str_remove("-$")
  )

options_html <- paste0(
  '<option value="', school_options$slug, '">', school_options$name, '</option>',
  collapse = "\n"
)

data_json <- toJSON(all_school_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
```

</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
var ALL_SCHOOLS = ', data_json, ';

var currentSchool = null;
var classChart = null;

function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

var ICONS = {
  community: \'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:var(--epi-navy); opacity:0.4;"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>\',
  visits: \'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:var(--epi-navy); opacity:0.4;"><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2"/><path d="M15 2H9a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v2a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h6a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1z"/><path d="M12 11h4"/><path d="M12 16h4"/><path d="M8 11h.01"/><path d="M8 16h.01"/></svg>\',
  issues: \'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#dc3545; opacity:0.6;"><path d="M10.29 3.86 1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>\'
};

function makeCard(value, label, icon) {
  return \'<div class="stat-card" style="padding:1rem;">\' +
    \'<span class="stat-value" style="font-size:1.8rem; display:block;">\' + value + \'</span>\' +
    \'<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.35rem; margin-top:0.25rem;">\' +
    (icon ? icon : "") +
    \'<span class="stat-label" style="font-size:0.75rem;">\' + label + \'</span>\' +
    \'</div></div>\';
}

function loadSchool(slug) {
  if (!slug) {
    document.getElementById("school-detail").style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  var data = ALL_SCHOOLS[slug];
  if (!data) {
    document.getElementById("school-detail").style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  currentSchool = data;
  currentSchool._slug = slug;
  document.getElementById("school-detail").style.display = "block";

  var info = data.info;

  // Header with year selector
  document.getElementById("school-name").textContent = info.school_name;
  var metaParts = [];
  if (info.Region) metaParts.push(info.Region + " Region");
  if (info["EPI Start Year"]) metaParts.push("EPI Partner Since " + info["EPI Start Year"]);
  if (info.Latitude && info.Longitude) {
    metaParts.push(\'<a href="https://www.google.com/maps?q=\' + info.Latitude + "," + info.Longitude + \'" target="_blank" style="color:var(--epi-yellow); text-decoration:underline;">View on Map</a>\');
  }
  document.getElementById("school-meta").innerHTML = metaParts.join(" &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; ");

  renderSchoolContent(slug, data);
}

function renderSchoolContent(slug, data) {
  var info = data.info;
  var start = document.getElementById("school-date-start").value;
  var end = document.getElementById("school-date-end").value;

  // Filter visits by date range
  var allVisits = data.visits || [];
  var visits = allVisits;
  if (start && end && Array.isArray(allVisits)) {
    visits = allVisits.filter(function(v) {
      var d = v.visit_date || v.StartDate || "";
      return inRange(d, start, end);
    });
  }

  // Info Cards
  var fu = data.full_update;
  var latestUpdate = (Array.isArray(fu) && fu.length > 0) ? fu[fu.length - 1] : null;

  var cards = "";
  if (latestUpdate && latestUpdate.Q5) {
    cards += makeCard(parseInt(latestUpdate.Q5).toLocaleString(), "Estimated Community Population", ICONS.community);
  }
  cards += makeCard(visits.length, "Visit(s) in Range", ICONS.visits);
  if (info.n_issues > 0) {
    cards += makeCard(info.n_issues, "Open Issues", ICONS.issues);
  }
  document.getElementById("info-cards").innerHTML = cards;

  // Programs
  var programMap = {
    "MGR": "MGR / Lanterns",
    "Non-Generating MGR": "Non-Generating MGR",
    "Library": "Library",
    "Computer": "Computers",
    "Feminine Hygiene Kits": "Menstrual Kits",
    "Science Kits": "Science Kits",
    "Construction Projects": "Construction",
    "Boreholes": "Boreholes",
    "Solar Power": "Solar Power",
    "Biofill Toilets": "Biofill Toilets",
    "Light a Village": "Light a Village"
  };
  var progHtml = Object.keys(programMap)
    .filter(function(key) { return info[key] == 1; })
    .map(function(key) { return \'<span class="badge-program">\' + programMap[key] + "</span>"; })
    .join(" ");
  document.getElementById("school-programs").innerHTML = progHtml || "<em>No programs recorded</em>";

  // School Details
  var detailsSection = document.getElementById("school-details-section");

  if (latestUpdate) {
    detailsSection.style.display = "block";

    // Enrollment pie chart (Primary vs JHS)
    var noDataMsg = document.getElementById("no-class-data");
    var canvas = document.getElementById("class-pie-chart");

    if (classChart) {
      classChart.destroy();
      classChart = null;
    }

    var primaryN = latestUpdate.Q8 ? parseInt(latestUpdate.Q8) : 0;
    var jhsN = (latestUpdate.Q11 && latestUpdate.Q11 !== "null") ? parseInt(latestUpdate.Q11) : 0;
    if (isNaN(jhsN)) jhsN = 0;

    if (primaryN > 0 || jhsN > 0) {
      canvas.style.display = "block";
      noDataMsg.style.display = "none";
      var chartLabels = [];
      var chartData = [];
      var chartColors = [];
      if (primaryN > 0) { chartLabels.push("Primary (" + primaryN + ")"); chartData.push(primaryN); chartColors.push("#1C2B4A"); }
      if (jhsN > 0) { chartLabels.push("JHS (" + jhsN + ")"); chartData.push(jhsN); chartColors.push("#F5B800"); }
      classChart = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: "pie",
        data: {
          labels: chartLabels,
          datasets: [{
            data: chartData,
            backgroundColor: chartColors
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: true,
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: "bottom", labels: { font: { size: 12 } } }
          }
        }
      });
    } else {
      canvas.style.display = "none";
      noDataMsg.style.display = "block";
    }

    // Details table — enrollment stats + last year academic outcomes
    var details = \'<table class="dashboard-table">\';
    if (latestUpdate.Q6) details += "<tr><td style=\\"font-weight:600; width:250px;\\">Students Enrolled</td><td>" + parseInt(latestUpdate.Q6).toLocaleString() + "</td></tr>";
    if (latestUpdate.Q7) details += "<tr><td style=\\"font-weight:600;\\">Teachers</td><td>" + latestUpdate.Q7 + "</td></tr>";
    details += "</table>";

    // Last year stats — compute actual year label from school year
    var hasLastYear = latestUpdate.Q9 || latestUpdate.Q12 || latestUpdate.Q13 || (latestUpdate.Q15 && latestUpdate.Q15 !== "N/A");
    if (hasLastYear) {
      // Determine the "previous year" based on the date range start
      var startDate = new Date(start + "T00:00:00");
      var syStartYear = startDate.getMonth() >= 7 ? startDate.getFullYear() : startDate.getFullYear() - 1;
      var prevYearLabel = "in " + syStartYear;
      details += \'<h5 style="margin:1.25rem 0 0.5rem; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.85rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; border-top:1px solid #e9ecef; padding-top:1rem;">Academic Outcomes \' + prevYearLabel + \'</h5>\';
      details += \'<table class="dashboard-table">\';
      if (latestUpdate.Q9) details += "<tr><td style=\\"font-weight:600; width:250px;\\">Completed Primary to JHS</td><td>" + latestUpdate.Q9 + " students</td></tr>";
      if (latestUpdate.Q12) details += "<tr><td style=\\"font-weight:600;\\">BECE Test Takers</td><td>" + latestUpdate.Q12 + "</td></tr>";
      if (latestUpdate.Q13) details += "<tr><td style=\\"font-weight:600;\\">BECE Passers</td><td>" + latestUpdate.Q13 + "</td></tr>";
      if (latestUpdate.Q15 && latestUpdate.Q15 !== "N/A") details += "<tr><td style=\\"font-weight:600;\\">Went on to Secondary/Technical</td><td>" + latestUpdate.Q15 + " students</td></tr>";
      details += "</table>";
    }

    document.getElementById("school-details").innerHTML = details;
  } else {
    detailsSection.style.display = "none";
  }

  // Notes From Last Visit — sort by date, take most recent
  var sortedVisits = (Array.isArray(visits) ? visits.slice() : []).sort(function(a, b) {
    var da = (a.visit_date || a.StartDate || "");
    var db = (b.visit_date || b.StartDate || "");
    return da < db ? -1 : da > db ? 1 : 0;
  });

  // Clickable header — links to visits page filtered to this school
  var notesHeader = document.getElementById("notes-header");
  notesHeader.onclick = function() {
    var schoolName = encodeURIComponent(data.info.school_name);
    window.location.href = "visits.html?school=" + schoolName;
  };

  if (sortedVisits.length > 0) {
    var v = sortedVisits[sortedVisits.length - 1]; // most recent
    var date = v.visit_date || v.StartDate || "";
    var vhtml = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1rem;">\';
    vhtml += \'<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:0.75rem;">\';
    if (date) vhtml += \'<span style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem;">\' + date + "</span>";
    if (v.visitor) vhtml += \'<span style="color:#666; font-size:0.85rem;">Staff: \' + v.visitor + "</span>";
    vhtml += "</div>";
    if (v.visit_reason) vhtml += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0.25rem 0;"><strong>Reason for visit:</strong> \' + v.visit_reason + "</p>";
    if (v.activities) vhtml += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0.25rem 0;"><strong>What was done:</strong> \' + v.activities + "</p>";

    // Strengths (Q26 / doing_well)
    if (v.doing_well && v.doing_well !== "null") {
      vhtml += \'<div style="background:#d4edda; border-radius:6px; padding:0.75rem; margin:0.75rem 0 0.5rem;">\';
      vhtml += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0;"><strong style="color:#155724;">Strengths:</strong> \' + v.doing_well + "</p></div>";
    }

    // Challenges (Q27 / struggles)
    if (v.struggles && v.struggles !== "null") {
      vhtml += \'<div style="background:#fff3cd; border-radius:6px; padding:0.75rem; margin:0.5rem 0;">\';
      vhtml += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0;"><strong style="color:#856404;">Challenges:</strong> \' + v.struggles + "</p></div>";
    }

    if (v.observations && v.observations !== "null") vhtml += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0.5rem 0 0; color:#666;"><strong>Observations:</strong> \' + v.observations + "</p>";
    vhtml += "</div>";
    document.getElementById("school-visits").innerHTML = vhtml;
  } else {
    document.getElementById("school-visits").innerHTML = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);"><em style="color:#999;">No visits recorded in this date range</em></div>\';
  }

  // Open Issues section
  var openIssues = data.open_issues || [];
  var issuesSection = document.getElementById("open-issues-section");
  var issuesContainer = document.getElementById("school-open-issues");
  if (Array.isArray(openIssues) && openIssues.length > 0) {
    issuesSection.style.display = "block";
    var ihtml = "";
    openIssues.forEach(function(issue) {
      var issueSlug = (issue.school_name || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/-$/, "");
      ihtml += \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.25rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:0.75rem; border-left:4px solid #dc3545; cursor:pointer;" onclick="window.location.href=\\\'issues.html\\\'">\';
      ihtml += \'<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">\';
      ihtml += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0; color:#333;">\' + (issue.urgent_issues || "") + \'</p>\';
      ihtml += \'<span style="color:#999; font-size:0.8rem; white-space:nowrap; margin-left:1rem;">\' + (issue.visit_date || "") + \'</span>\';
      ihtml += \'</div>\';
      if (issue.visitor) ihtml += \'<p style="font-size:0.8rem; margin:0.25rem 0 0; color:#999;">Flagged by \' + issue.visitor + \'</p>\';
      ihtml += \'</div>\';
    });
    issuesContainer.innerHTML = ihtml;
  } else {
    issuesSection.style.display = "none";
  }

  loadCachedSummary(slug, data);
}

function simpleHash(str) {
  var hash = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = hash & hash;
  }
  return hash.toString(36);
}

function buildNotes(data) {
  return (data.visits || []).map(function(v) {
    var parts = [];
    if (v.doing_well) parts.push("Doing well: " + v.doing_well);
    if (v.struggles) parts.push("Struggles: " + v.struggles);
    if (v.urgent_issues) parts.push("Urgent issues: " + v.urgent_issues);
    if (v.observations) parts.push("Other observations: " + v.observations);
    return parts.join("; ");
  }).filter(function(n) { return n.trim() !== ""; });
}

function loadCachedSummary(slug, data) {
  var notes = buildNotes(data);
  var cacheKey = "epi-summary-" + slug;
  var cached = null;
  try { cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(cacheKey)); } catch(e) {}
  var currentHash = simpleHash(JSON.stringify(notes));
  var btn = document.getElementById("btn-generate-summary");
  if (cached && cached.hash === currentHash && cached.summary) {
    var cachedFormatted = cached.summary.replace(/\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>");
    document.getElementById("ai-summary").innerHTML =
      \'<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; line-height:1.6;">\' + cachedFormatted + \'</div>\' +
      \'<p style="color:#999; font-size:0.75rem; margin-top:0.5rem;">Cached summary from \' + cached.date + \'</p>\';
    if (btn) btn.textContent = "Regenerate Summary";
  } else {
    document.getElementById("ai-summary").innerHTML = "";
    if (btn) btn.textContent = "Generate AI Summary";
  }
}

async function generateSummary(force) {
  if (!currentSchool) return;
  var notes = buildNotes(currentSchool);
  if (notes.length === 0) {
    document.getElementById("ai-summary").innerHTML = \'<em style="color:#999;">No visit notes available for summary.</em>\';
    return;
  }

  var slug = currentSchool._slug;
  var notesHash = simpleHash(JSON.stringify(notes));

  // Check cache unless forced
  if (!force) {
    var cacheKey = "epi-summary-" + slug;
    var cached = null;
    try { cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(cacheKey)); } catch(e) {}
    if (cached && cached.hash === notesHash && cached.summary) {
      var cachedFmt = cached.summary.replace(/\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>");
      document.getElementById("ai-summary").innerHTML =
        \'<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; line-height:1.6;">\' + cachedFmt + \'</div>\' +
        \'<p style="color:#999; font-size:0.75rem; margin-top:0.5rem;">Cached summary from \' + cached.date + \'</p>\';
      return;
    }
  }

  var summaryDiv = document.getElementById("ai-summary");
  summaryDiv.innerHTML = \'<em style="color:var(--epi-navy);">Generating summary...</em>\';

  try {
    var resp = await fetch("/api/summary", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        school_name: currentSchool.info.school_name,
        notes: notes
      })
    });
    var result = await resp.json();
    if (result.error) {
      summaryDiv.innerHTML = \'<em style="color:#dc3545;">Error: \' + result.error + (result.details ? \' — \' + result.details : \'\') + \'</em>\';
    } else {
      // Convert markdown bold **text** to HTML <strong>
      var formattedSummary = result.summary.replace(/\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>");
      summaryDiv.innerHTML = \'<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; line-height:1.6;">\' + formattedSummary + \'</div>\';
      // Cache the result
      try {
        localStorage.setItem("epi-summary-" + slug, JSON.stringify({
          hash: notesHash,
          summary: result.summary,
          date: new Date().toLocaleDateString()
        }));
      } catch(e) {}
      var btn = document.getElementById("btn-generate-summary");
      if (btn) btn.textContent = "Regenerate Summary";
    }
  } catch (err) {
    summaryDiv.innerHTML = \'<em style="color:#dc3545;">Failed to connect to AI service. Please try again later.</em>\';
  }
}

// Date range Apply/Reset
document.getElementById("btn-school-apply").addEventListener("click", function() {
  if (currentSchool) renderSchoolContent(currentSchool._slug, currentSchool);
});
document.getElementById("btn-school-reset").addEventListener("click", function() {
  var now = new Date();
  var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
  document.getElementById("school-date-start").value = syYear + "-08-01";
  document.getElementById("school-date-end").value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (currentSchool) renderSchoolContent(currentSchool._slug, currentSchool);
});

// Auto-select school from URL parameter (e.g. ?school=school-slug)
(function() {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var schoolSlug = params.get("school");
  if (schoolSlug) {
    var sel = document.getElementById("school-dropdown");
    if (sel) {
      sel.value = schoolSlug;
      loadSchool(schoolSlug);
    }
  }
})();
</script>
'))
